value.rationale: A precise sign-safe sketch budget is a natural correctness/stability parameter for deterministic sketched eigenvalue computation on SPD problems. The forced exceptional row makes the statement independent of a particular full-rank oversampling heuristic and reveals square-root ambient-dimensional growth at fixed spectral condition.
